sections.heading: Definition
sections.body: Astrocartography projects the natal chart onto a world map. Each planet forms lines showing where it was angular at birth. Near a line, that planet's symbolism tends to be louder in the person's experience of that place.

sections.heading: Four Angles
sections.body: The Ascendant line emphasizes identity, body, vitality, and how the person shows up. The Midheaven line emphasizes career, public role, visibility, and reputation. The Descendant line emphasizes relationships, projection, and the people the person meets. The IC line emphasizes home, roots, privacy, family, and emotional foundation.

sections.heading: Proximity
sections.body: Effects are strongest close to the line and more diffuse with distance. Where two lines cross or closely overlap, both planets should be considered active. The app should compute distance and line intersections separately from this interpretive file.

sections.heading: Non-Deterministic Policy
sections.body: A line describes what a location may amplify; it does not guarantee events or define a fixed outcome. Heavier lines such as Mars, Saturn, Neptune, or Pluto should not be framed as places to avoid. They should be described as places that ask more of the person in a specific way.

sections.heading: App Policy
sections.body: Keep astrocartography behind a later optional feature. Do not surface this in the main chart, daily transits, synastry, or timing engine until map calculation and rendering are implemented. When released, require exact birth date, time, and location, and label the result as locational astrology.

sections.heading: Line Meanings
sections.body: Use these as short interpretive anchors for planet-angle combinations. The voice layer may expand or soften them later.

items.label: Sun Ascendant
items.body: Visibility, vitality, confidence, and self-expression are amplified. Strong for being seen and leading. Watch for inflated ego.

items.label: Sun Midheaven
items.body: Career, reputation, leadership, and recognition are emphasized. Strong for public visibility. Watch for tying identity too tightly to status.

items.label: Sun Descendant
items.body: Relationships bring visibility and may revolve around prominent or confident people. Watch for outshining or being outshone.

items.label: Sun IC
items.body: Home, roots, and belonging become central. Strong for building a base that feels personally affirming. Watch for making home the whole world.

items.label: Moon Ascendant
items.body: Feelings sit close to the surface, and people read the person more easily. Strong for familiarity and intuition. Watch for moods steering the day.

items.label: Moon Midheaven
items.body: Emotional life and public life intertwine. The person may be known for care, nurture, responsiveness, or feeling. Watch for managing emotions for appearances.

items.label: Moon Descendant
items.body: Relationships feel nurturing, familiar, and emotionally important. Strong for family-style bonds. Watch for dependency.

items.label: Moon IC
items.body: A strong home-feeling line, often linked with comfort, roots, memory, and belonging. Watch for clinging to safety.

items.label: Mercury Ascendant
items.body: Thinking, speech, curiosity, and networking sharpen. Strong for learning and connection. Watch for mental overload.

items.label: Mercury Midheaven
items.body: Career runs through communication, ideas, writing, trade, analysis, or teaching. Watch for spreading attention too thin.

items.label: Mercury Descendant
items.body: Relationships develop through conversation, shared ideas, negotiation, and intellectual exchange. Watch for staying in the head.

items.label: Mercury IC
items.body: Home life becomes busy with conversation, movement, learning, or writing. Watch for restlessness in private life.

items.label: Venus Ascendant
items.body: Charm, beauty, affection, ease, and social warmth are amplified. Strong for love, pleasure, and style. Watch for coasting on charm.

items.label: Venus Midheaven
items.body: Public life gains grace and appeal. Work may involve art, beauty, money, design, or relationships. Watch for image over substance.

items.label: Venus Descendant
items.body: Partnership, affection, attraction, and harmony are emphasized. Strong for love and social ease. Watch for avoiding necessary conflict.

items.label: Venus IC
items.body: Home can feel beautiful, comfortable, and loving. Strong for domestic pleasure. Watch for comfort that avoids growth.

items.label: Mars Ascendant
items.body: Drive, heat, courage, and assertion rise. Strong for action and physical vitality. Watch for haste, friction, and a shorter fuse.

items.label: Mars Midheaven
items.body: Ambition, competition, and professional drive intensify. Strong for bold career moves. Watch for conflict and burnout.

items.label: Mars Descendant
items.body: Relationships run hot, with both chemistry and friction. Strong for passion and directness. Watch for power struggles.

items.label: Mars IC
items.body: Energy and sometimes tension concentrate in home and family life. Strong for building a base. Watch for conflict at home.

items.label: Jupiter Ascendant
items.body: Confidence, expansion, opportunity, and goodwill increase. Strong for growth and openness. Watch for overconfidence.

items.label: Jupiter Midheaven
items.body: Career and reputation can grow through opportunity, mentorship, publishing, teaching, or visibility. Watch for overreach.

items.label: Jupiter Descendant
items.body: Relationships bring generosity, access, teaching, growth, or open doors. Watch for overpromising.

items.label: Jupiter IC
items.body: Home and roots feel abundant and expansive. Strong for building a larger base. Watch for overextending.

items.label: Saturn Ascendant
items.body: Life feels more serious, disciplined, and demanding. Strong for maturity and self-command. Watch for loneliness or reading weight as failure.

items.label: Saturn Midheaven
items.body: Career requires patience, endurance, responsibility, and long-range building. Strong for lasting work. Watch for pressure and never-enough thinking.

items.label: Saturn Descendant
items.body: Relationships become serious, tested, committed, or delayed. Strong for durable bonds. Watch for coldness or isolation.

items.label: Saturn IC
items.body: Home and roots carry weight, duty, or history. Strong for building a durable foundation. Watch for heaviness in private life.

items.label: Uranus Ascendant
items.body: Freedom, originality, reinvention, and instability increase. Strong for breakthroughs. Watch for restlessness and abrupt change.

items.label: Uranus Midheaven
items.body: Career can turn toward innovation, independence, disruption, or unconventional work. Watch for instability and burning bridges.

items.label: Uranus Descendant
items.body: Relationships become unusual, fast-forming, freedom-seeking, or changeable. Watch for sudden exits.

items.label: Uranus IC
items.body: Home life may become unconventional, mobile, experimental, or unsettled. Watch for rootlessness.

items.label: Neptune Ascendant
items.body: Imagination, sensitivity, spiritual seeking, and porous identity increase. Strong for art and compassion. Watch for confusion and losing edges.

items.label: Neptune Midheaven
items.body: Career may involve art, healing, image, service, or inspiration, but direction can blur. Watch for confusion about the path.

items.label: Neptune Descendant
items.body: Relationships can feel romantic, compassionate, idealized, or hard to define. Watch for projection and disillusionment.

items.label: Neptune IC
items.body: Home becomes dreamy, private, spiritual, creative, or hard to ground. Watch for escapism and unclear footing.

items.label: Pluto Ascendant
items.body: Intensity, power, privacy, and deep personal change are amplified. Strong for reinvention. Watch for control struggles.

items.label: Pluto Midheaven
items.body: Career can involve influence, pressure, depth work, crisis work, or transformation. Watch for ruthless dynamics.

items.label: Pluto Descendant
items.body: Relationships become intense, transformative, magnetic, or all-or-nothing. Watch for obsession and power struggles.

items.label: Pluto IC
items.body: Home and roots undergo deep change or private excavation. Strong for rebuilding from the foundation. Watch for control dynamics at home.
